originality.rationale: Rooted chordless paths as prime stems and prime-stem pseudo-closure are established in Kashiwabara--Nakamura 2013 and credited. The new compounded all-graphic classification additionally establishes pseudo-intent exhaustiveness, unique minimality, exact one-pass direct-unit basis, a graph-theoretic directness boundary, and factorial-versus-cubic complete-graph count; no equivalent full coverage identified in searches or inspected primary sources.
